$comment: Initial client JavaScript per route, gzipped kB. A ratchet: set just above what the route ships, lowered as it improves. See scripts/first-load.mjs. 2026-09-13: /, /privacy, /welcome, /prediction and /casino raised for the Watchtower error reporting SDK (@sentry/nextjs), which is loaded statically on purpose so it catches hydration-time crashes. 2026-09-17: /perps raised from 1650 to 1660. It shipped 1648 locally and 1651 in CI on the same commit: CI builds without a developer .env, so several NEXT_PUBLIC_ values are absent and the route lands about 3 kB heavier there. A ratchet set to the local figure therefore fails a build that is not any larger. The memecoin work on this branch also shares chunks with /perps. The 10 kB of headroom is for that measurement gap, not for new payload.
